festivals.name: Upfest
festivals.location: Bedminster & Southville, Bristol — hub around North Street / Tobacco Factory
festivals.statusNote: Biennial — alternates a full festival with the shorter "Upfest Presents" programme. Active.
festivals.summary: Europe's largest street art & graffiti festival. Hundreds of artists paint shopfronts, walls and hoardings across south Bristol, plus live music, workshops, tours and a paint market. Free to attend.
